title: Seal in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='26' ry='22' fill='#7B8FA6'/>
  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='16' ry='15' fill='#A8BDD4'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='19' ry='17' fill='#8FA6BD'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#C9D9E8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#3E4C5C'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='37' r='3' fill='#1E2833'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='37' r='3' fill='#1E2833'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='36' r='1' fill='#E8F4FF'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='36' r='1' fill='#E8F4FF'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='40' y1='47' x2='28' y2='44' stroke='#5B6B7D' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='49' x2='27' y2='50' stroke='#5B6B7D' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='47' x2='72' y2='44' stroke='#5B6B7D' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='49' x2='73' y2='50' stroke='#5B6B7D' stroke-width='1.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- scarf -->
  <path d='M30 55 Q50 63 70 55 L70 61 Q50 69 30 61 Z' fill='#E8483C'/>
  <!-- scarf knot -->
  <rect x='44' y='60' width='8' height='6' rx='2' fill='#C9302A'/>
  <!-- scarf tail -->
  <path d='M48 65 L42 74 L46 75 L51 67 Z' fill='#E8483C'/>
  <!-- front flippers -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='72' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6B8098' transform='rotate(-20 28 72)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='72' rx='7' ry='4' fill='#6B8098' transform='rotate(20 72 72)'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M24 84 Q18 80 14 84 Q20 88 24 84 Z' fill='#6B8098'/>
  <path d='M76 84 Q82 80 86 84 Q80 88 76 84 Z' fill='#6B8098'/>
</svg>
